text:
Ava Chen: Quick design review request — onboarding for autoscale controls (SLO slider, min/max, burst, pool selector). Need copy + a11y sweep.
Liam Patel: Saw it. Main UX friction: SLO default too aggressive; new users get surprised by min jumping. Propose soft default 70%.
Sofi Gomez: Accessibility: pool picker traps focus on close in VoiceOver and some cards reuse headings. Make it role=dialog, aria-modal=true, restore focus to trigger. Add unique aria-labels for cards.
Marco Rivera: Users assume "burst" is permanent. Suggest label: "Burst (temporary)" and helper: "Short-term extra GPUs — billed separately."
Ellie Tran: Fallback messaging is vague. Current toast "Fallback active" — we should state what is routed where and perf/privacy caveats. Draft toast: "Fallback active: selected GPU pool at capacity. Routing to Redwood Hosted for availability. Data remains encrypted in transit. Reserve Dedicated capacity to avoid routing. (Details)"
Ava Chen: Also thinking of showing an inline cost delta next to the slider and a tiny sparkline under min/max when min=0 + burst enabled to illustrate cold-start risk.
Liam Patel: Will prototype the $/hour delta and a micro-sparkline. Keep it subtle and opt-in on hover for methodology.
Sofi Gomez: Slider needs aria-valuetext like: "Reliability 70 percent; increasing reliability may increase cost." For condensed visual copy add visually-hidden full text for screen readers.
Marco Rivera: Microcopy options for burst: Option A: "Temporary burst capacity: short-term extra GPUs to handle spikes. Auto scales down after 10 minutes." Option B (short): "Short-term extra GPUs (auto-remove)."
Ellie Tran: Also propose a non-blocking inline banner in the console whenever fallback is active that links to a modal explaining tradeoffs. I'll draft the modal content.
deploy-bot: autoscale-ui-v2 deployed to staging at 2024-11-06T16:22Z — validate keyboard + screen reader flows before promoting.
Ava Chen: Action items: Marco finalize copy variants, Liam mock cost delta + sparkline, Sofi run keyboard/VO pass and add notes in Figma, Ellie draft fallback modal. Target: staging verification EOD Thursday.
Liam Patel: On it — prototyping today.
Sofi Gomez: I'll start the a11y pass tomorrow AM and drop ARIA snippets.
Marco Rivera: Will post two copy variants by EOD.
Ava Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma and paste the link here when ready. :raised_hands:
